records.literal_gloss: And he showed me Joshua the priest the great standing before [the] angel of Yahweh, and the satan standing at his right [hand] to accuse him.

en.L: And he showed me Joshua the high priest, who was standing before the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.
en.B: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest. He stood before the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the Accuser stood at his right side to accuse him.
en.R: Then he showed me Joshua the high priest. He was standing in front of the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The Accuser was standing at Joshua's right side, ready to bring charges against him.

es.L: Y me mostró a Josué el sumo sacerdote, que estaba de pie delante del ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y al satán, que estaba de pie a su mano derecha para acusarlo.
es.B: Luego me mostró al sumo sacerdote Josué. Estaba de pie delante del ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y el Acusador estaba a su derecha para acusarlo.
es.R: Luego me mostró al sumo sacerdote Josué. Estaba de pie frente al ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. El Acusador estaba a la derecha de Josué, listo para presentar cargos contra él.

fr.L: Et il me fit voir Josué, le grand prêtre, qui se tenait devant l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et le satan qui se tenait à sa droite pour l’accuser.

vi.L: Và người cho tôi thấy Giô-suê, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, đang đứng trước thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và kẻ sa-tan đứng bên tay phải người để tố cáo người.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 나에게 대제사장 여호수아를 보여 주었는데, 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사 앞에 서 있었고, 그 사탄은 그를 고발하려고 그의 오른쪽에 서 있었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤에 그가 나에게 대제사장 여호수아를 보여 주었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사 앞에 서 있었고, 고발자가 그를 고발하려고 그의 오른쪽에 서 있었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤에 그가 나에게 대제사장 여호수아를 보여 주었다. 여호수아는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사 앞에 서 있었다. 고발자는 여호수아의 오른쪽에 서서 그를 고발하려 하고 있었다.

decisions.choice: the fourth vision: the high priest accused, cleared and dressed in clean clothes
decisions.reason: The vision is a scene in a court. Joshua stands before the angel of the LORD as one accused, and the accuser stands ready to bring the charge. The LORD rejects the accusation (verse 2), Joshua's filthy clothes are taken off and replaced, and the angel explains that his guilt has been removed (verse 4). Through their high priest, the people who came back from exile are told that God has cleansed them and will accept their worship.

decisions.choice: Joshua the high priest: Joshua son of Jehozadak, the high priest of the returned exiles
decisions.reason: He is named "Joshua son of Jehozadak" in 6:11 and in Haggai (see the note at Haggai 1:1), and "Jeshua son of Jozadak" in Ezra (Ezra 3:2). His grandfather Seraiah was the last high priest before the exile and was put to death by the Babylonians (2 Kings 25:18-21; 1 Chronicles 5:40-41). Joshua led the priests who rebuilt the altar and the temple alongside Zerubbabel the governor.

decisions.choice: the satan: a title, "the accuser", one who brings a charge in court
decisions.reason: As in Job 1:6, the word has the article, "the satan", so it is a title or role, not a personal name. Here the role is plain: he stands at the right hand of the accused, where an accuser stood in court (Psalm 109:6), and the verb that follows, "to accuse him", comes from the same root as his title. Later Scripture uses the word as a name, Satan, and Revelation 12:10 calls him the accuser of God's people. See the note at Job 1:6.

decisions.choice: he showed me: the LORD, or the angel who talked with me
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. In 2:3 it is the LORD who shows Zechariah a vision; elsewhere it is the angel who talked with him. Either way, the vision is given to the prophet, not made up by him.

decisions.choice: the satan (L); the Accuser (B, R); to accuse him (all levels)
decisions.reason: The wording follows Job: Literal keeps "the satan", with the article and lowercase, to show that it is a title, and Balanced and Readable translate the title as "the Accuser". Every level says "accuse", so the play on the word stays visible. Readable splits the verse into short sentences and says "bring charges against him".

decisions.choice: "el satán" (L), "el Acusador" (B, R); "acusarlo" at every level; "el sumo sacerdote Josué"
decisions.reason: As the published Spanish Job 1-2: the title has the article and stays lowercase at Literal, and Balanced and Readable translate it. "Acusador ... acusarlo" keeps the play on the root (m3). Joshua is "Josué", as in Haggai, linked to Ezra's "Jesúa".

decisions.choice: "le satan" (L), "l'Accusateur" (B, R); "l'accuser" at every level; "Josué, le grand prêtre"
decisions.reason: As the published French Job 1-2. "Accusateur ... accuser" keeps the play on the root (m3); the name "Satan" is not used, since the Hebrew has a title with the article.

decisions.choice: the vision narrated in the passé simple at L and B ("il me fit voir") and the passé composé at R ("il m'a montré")
decisions.reason: Zechariah's visions are first-person narrative, as set for French in these books; what is said in the heavenly court stays speech.

decisions.choice: "yule satani" (L), "Mshtaki" (B, R); "kumshtaki" at every level; "Yoshua kuhani mkuu"
decisions.reason: Swahili follows the published Job 1:6-7 ("yule satani", "Mshtaki"), which the reader has already met, rather than the term sheet's "yule shetani". "Mshtaki ... kumshtaki" keeps the play on the root (m3).

decisions.choice: "kẻ sa-tan" (L), "Kẻ Tố Cáo" (B, R); "tố cáo" at every level; "Giô-suê, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm"
decisions.reason: As the published Vietnamese Job 1-2. "Kẻ Tố Cáo ... tố cáo" keeps the play on the root (m3); "Sa-tan" as a name (1 Chronicles 21:1) is not used. The high priest follows the term sheet ("Giô-suê").

decisions.choice: "그 사탄" (L), "고발자" (B, R); "고발하려고" at every level; "대제사장 여호수아"
decisions.reason: As the published Korean Job 1-2 (그 사탄 / 고발자), which wins over the term sheet's 고발하는 자. 고발자 ... 고발하다 keeps the play on the root (m3). The one who shows the vision is not named, so he takes no honorific.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֗ן יִגְעַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה בְּךָ֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן וְיִגְעַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּךָ֔ הַבֹּחֵ֖ר בִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲל֧וֹא זֶ֦ה א֖וּד מֻצָּ֥ל מֵאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Yahweh to the satan, May rebuke Yahweh you, the satan; and may rebuke Yahweh you, the one choosing Jerusalem! [Is] not this a brand plucked from [the] fire?

en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to the Accuser, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rebuke you, Accuser! May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! Is this man not a burning stick snatched from the fire?"
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to the Accuser, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rebuke you, Accuser! May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who has chosen Jerusalem, rebuke you! This man is like a burning stick that has been pulled out of a fire, is he not?"

es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo al Acusador: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te reprenda, Acusador! ¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que ha escogido a Jerusalén, te reprenda! Este hombre es como un palo encendido que se saca del fuego, ¿no es así?».

sw.L: Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia yule satani, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akukemee, wewe satani! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyeichagua Yerusalemu, akukemee! Je, huyu si kijinga kilichonyakuliwa motoni?"

vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Kẻ Tố Cáo: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} quở trách ngươi, hỡi Kẻ Tố Cáo! Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã chọn Giê-ru-sa-lem, quở trách ngươi! Người này giống như que củi đang cháy được kéo ra khỏi lửa, phải không?"

ko.L: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 사탄에게 말씀하셨다. "사탄아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 꾸짖으시기를 [빈다]! 예루살렘을 택하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 꾸짖으시기를 [빈다]! 이 사람은 불 속에서 끄집어낸 나무토막이 아니냐?"

ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고발자에게 말씀하셨다. "고발자야, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 꾸짖으시기를 바란다! 예루살렘을 택하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 꾸짖으시기를 바란다! 이 사람은 불 속에서 겨우 꺼낸, 타다 남은 나무토막 같은 사람이 아니냐?"

decisions.choice: the LORD said: the LORD speaks, perhaps through the angel of the LORD
alternatives: the angel of the LORD said
decisions.reason: The words that follow speak of the LORD in the third person ("May the LORD rebuke you"), which suits the angel of the LORD (verse 1) better than the LORD himself. The Syriac translation reads "the angel of the LORD said". The Hebrew may mean that the angel speaks as the LORD's voice, as the angel of the LORD often does (see the note at Genesis 16:7), or the LORD may speak of himself by name, as he does elsewhere. This description of the Syriac is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: may the LORD rebuke you: may the LORD silence you and reject your charge
decisions.reason: To rebuke is to stop someone with a stern word (Psalm 9:6; Malachi 3:11). The accusation is not even argued: it is thrown out. Jude 9 has the archangel Michael say to the devil, "The Lord rebuke you", using the same words.

decisions.choice: a burning stick snatched from the fire: someone rescued at the last moment
decisions.reason: Amos 4:11 uses the same picture of Israel: "you were like a burning stick snatched from the fire". Joshua, and the people with him, came through the fire of the exile and were pulled out just in time. The LORD did not rescue him only to condemn him now.

decisions.choice: who has chosen Jerusalem: the LORD's choice of Jerusalem is the reason the charge fails
decisions.reason: The LORD has chosen Jerusalem again (1:17; 2:16). The accusation against Jerusalem's high priest is an attack on that choice, so it is rejected.

decisions.choice: satan (L); Accuser (B, R); this man (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew calls him "the satan" here too, as a form of address. Literal says "satan", lowercase, and Balanced and Readable "Accuser", as in verse 1. Balanced and Readable say "this man" for "this", since Joshua is meant, and Readable makes the question a statement with a tag.

decisions.choice: "Que el SEÑOR te reprenda" (as Jude 9); "un tizón arrancado del fuego" (L), "un palo encendido sacado del fuego" (B, R), as Amos 4:11
decisions.reason: The rebuke keeps the words of the published Jude 9, which quotes this line, and the picture keeps the published Spanish of Amos 4:11, where it is used of Israel (m3).

decisions.choice: "Que le SEIGNEUR te réprimande" (as Jude 9); "un tison arraché du feu" (L), "retiré du feu" (B)
decisions.reason: The rebuke keeps the verb of the published Jude 9, and the burning stick the words of Amos 4:11 in French.

decisions.choice: "BWANA akukemee" (as Jude 9); "kijinga kilichonyakuliwa motoni" (L), "kijinga kinachowaka kilichotolewa motoni" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The rebuke is the wording of the published Jude 9, and the picture that of Amos 4:11 in Swahili.

decisions.choice: "Nguyện CHÚA quở trách ngươi" (as Jude 9); "que củi được rút ra khỏi lửa" (L), "que củi đang cháy được kéo ra khỏi lửa" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The wording of the published Jude 9 and Amos 4:11 in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 꾸짖으시기를 바란다", with the honorific
decisions.reason: The words speak of the LORD in the third person and suit the angel of the LORD speaking as his voice (m1), so they keep the honorific of the published Jude 9 (주님께서 너를 꾸짖으시기를 바란다). The picture is that of Amos 4:11 in Korean.

source.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֕עַ הָיָ֥ה לָבֻ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים צוֹאִ֑ים וְעֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י הַמַּלְאָֽךְ׃

en.L: Now Joshua was clothed in filthy garments, and he was standing before the angel.
en.B: Joshua was dressed in filthy clothes as he stood before the angel.
en.R: Joshua was wearing filthy clothes as he stood in front of the angel.

es.B: Josué estaba vestido con ropas inmundas mientras estaba de pie delante del ángel.
es.R: Josué llevaba puesta una ropa asquerosa mientras estaba de pie frente al ángel.

fr.L: Or Josué était vêtu de vêtements souillés d’ordures, et il se tenait devant l’ange.
fr.B: Josué portait des vêtements immondes, debout devant l’ange.
fr.R: Josué portait des vêtements répugnants pendant qu’il se tenait devant l’ange.

sw.B: Yoshua alikuwa amevaa nguo chafu kabisa alipokuwa amesimama mbele ya malaika.
sw.R: Yoshua alikuwa amevaa nguo chafu mno alipokuwa amesimama mbele ya malaika.

vi.B: Giô-suê mặc áo quần nhơ nhớp khi đứng trước thiên sứ.

ko.L: 그때 여호수아는 오물로 더러워진 옷을 입고 천사 앞에 서 있었다.
ko.B: 여호수아는 더러운 옷을 입은 채 천사 앞에 서 있었다.
ko.R: 여호수아는 몹시 더러운 옷을 입고 천사 앞에 서 있었다.

decisions.choice: filthy garments: clothes soiled with filth
decisions.reason: The word is related to the word for human waste (Deuteronomy 23:14; Isaiah 28:8) and is one of the strongest Hebrew words for filth. A priest had to be clean to serve before God, and the high priest wore holy garments (Exodus 28:2; Leviticus 16:4). Joshua's clothes are a picture of the guilt that made him, and the people he represented, unfit to serve (verse 4).

decisions.choice: filthy, at every level
decisions.reason: Every level keeps a strong word, because the Hebrew word is meant to shock.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־הָעֹמְדִ֤יםלְפָנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָסִ֛ירוּ הַבְּגָדִ֥ים הַצֹּאִ֖ים מֵעָלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו רְאֵ֨ה הֶעֱבַ֤רְתִּי מֵעָלֶ֨יךָ֙ עֲוֺנֶ֔ךָ וְהַלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֹתְךָ֖ מַחֲלָצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he answered and said to those standing before him, saying, Remove the garments the filthy from on him. And he said to him, See, I have caused to pass from on you your iniquity, and I will clothe you [in] festal robes.

en.L: And he answered and said to those standing before him, "Take the filthy garments off him." And he said to him, "See, I have taken your iniquity away from you, and I will clothe you with festal robes."
en.B: The angel said to those who were standing before him, "Remove his filthy clothes." Then he told Joshua, "See, I have taken your guilt away from you, and I will dress you in fine robes."
en.R: The angel said to those standing in front of him, "Take those filthy clothes off him." Then he said to Joshua, "Look, I have taken away your sin, and I will dress you in fine clothes."

es.L: Y él respondió y dijo a los que estaban de pie delante de él: «{{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}} las vestiduras inmundas». Y le dijo: «Mira, he quitado de ti tu iniquidad, y te vestiré con ropas de gala».
es.B: El ángel dijo a los que estaban delante de él: «{{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}} esa ropa inmunda». Luego le dijo a Josué: «Mira, te he quitado tu culpa, y te vestiré con ropas finas».
es.R: El ángel dijo a los que estaban frente a él: «{{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}} esa ropa asquerosa». Luego le dijo a Josué: «Mira, te he quitado tu pecado, y te vestiré con ropa fina».

fr.L: Et il prit la parole et dit à ceux qui se tenaient devant lui : « Ôtez-lui les vêtements souillés. » Et il lui dit : « Vois, j’ai fait passer loin de toi ta faute, et je te revêtirai d’habits de fête. »
fr.B: L’ange dit à ceux qui se tenaient devant lui : « Enlevez-lui ses vêtements immondes. » Puis il dit à Josué : « Vois, je t’ai enlevé ta faute, et je vais te revêtir de beaux habits. »
fr.R: L’ange a dit à ceux qui se tenaient devant lui : « Enlevez-lui ces vêtements répugnants. » Puis il a dit à Josué : « Regarde, j’ai enlevé ton péché, et je vais t’habiller de beaux vêtements. »

sw.L: Naye akajibu, akawaambia wale waliosimama mbele yake, akisema, "Mvueni mavazi hayo machafu." Naye akamwambia, "Tazama, nimekuondolea uovu wako, nami nitakuvika mavazi ya sikukuu."
sw.B: Malaika akawaambia wale waliokuwa wamesimama mbele yake, "Mvueni nguo hizo chafu." Kisha akamwambia Yoshua, "Tazama, nimeiondoa hatia yako, nami nitakuvika mavazi mazuri."
sw.R: Malaika akawaambia wale waliosimama mbele yake, "Mvueni nguo hizo chafu." Kisha akamwambia Yoshua, "Tazama, nimeiondoa dhambi yako, nami nitakuvika nguo nzuri."

vi.L: Thiên sứ đáp và nói với những người đứng trước mặt mình rằng: "Hãy cởi bỏ áo quần dơ bẩn khỏi người." Rồi thiên sứ nói với người: "Kìa, ta đã cất tội ác ngươi khỏi ngươi, và ta sẽ mặc cho ngươi áo lễ."
vi.B: Thiên sứ bảo những người đứng trước mặt mình: "Hãy cởi bộ áo quần nhơ nhớp ra khỏi người." Rồi thiên sứ nói với Giô-suê: "Này, ta đã cất tội lỗi ngươi đi, và ta sẽ mặc cho ngươi áo đẹp."
vi.R: Thiên sứ bảo những người đứng trước mặt mình: "Hãy cởi bộ quần áo bẩn thỉu ấy ra khỏi người." Rồi thiên sứ nói với Giô-suê: "Này, ta đã cất tội lỗi ngươi đi, và ta sẽ mặc cho ngươi quần áo đẹp."

ko.L: 그가 대답하여 자기 앞에 서 있는 자들에게 말하였다. "그에게서 더러운 옷을 벗겨라." 그리고 그에게 말하였다. "보아라, 내가 네 죄악을 너에게서 없애 주었으니, 너에게 예복을 입히겠다."
ko.B: 천사가 자기 앞에 서 있는 이들에게 말했다. "그의 더러운 옷을 벗겨라." 그리고 여호수아에게 말했다. "보아라, 내가 네 죄를 없애 주었다. 이제 너에게 아름다운 예복을 입히겠다."
ko.R: 천사가 자기 앞에 서 있는 이들에게 말했다. "저 더러운 옷을 벗겨라." 그러고 나서 여호수아에게 말했다. "보아라, 내가 네 죄를 없앴다. 이제 너에게 좋은 옷을 입혀 주겠다."

decisions.choice: the angel gives the order to those who serve him
decisions.reason: The speaker is the angel of the LORD, before whom Joshua stands (verse 3). "Those standing before him" are heavenly attendants who wait on him, as servants stand before a king.

decisions.choice: I have taken your iniquity away: the change of clothes is a picture of forgiveness
decisions.reason: The angel explains the sign: the filthy clothes are Joshua's guilt, and their removal is its removal. The high priest carried the guilt of the people's offerings (Exodus 28:38), so his cleansing means that the people's worship can be accepted again. The verb is used of guilt taken away in 2 Samuel 12:13 ("the LORD has taken away your sin").

decisions.choice: festal robes: fine clothes worn on special occasions
decisions.reason: The word is rare; Isaiah 3:22 lists it among the finery of Jerusalem's rich women. The filthy clothes are not only taken away but replaced by clothes fit for a festival.

decisions.choice: The angel (B, R); Joshua (B, R); guilt (B); sin (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the speaker and the one spoken to, which the Hebrew leaves to the reader. The word for iniquity follows the wording set for the prophets: "iniquity" at Literal, "guilt" or "sin" at Balanced and "sin" at Readable.

decisions.choice: "{{plural_you:Quítenle|Quitadle}}"
decisions.reason: The order is given to the attendants, a group (m1), so the imperative takes plural_you; the angel says tú to Joshua.

decisions.choice: the angel of the LORD says "ta" (lowercase, no span) and "ngươi" to Joshua
decisions.reason: The angel of the LORD speaks here with the LORD's authority, forgiving guilt (m2), so he speaks as a master to the accused rather than as the guide speaks to Zechariah; he takes no deity_pronoun span.

source.text: וָאֹמַ֕ר יָשִׂ֛ימוּ צָנִ֥יף טָה֖וֹר עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיָּשִׂימוּ֩ הַצָּנִ֨יף הַטָּה֜וֹר עַל־רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וַיַּלְבִּשֻׁ֨הוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֔ים וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָ֖ה עֹמֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And I said, Let them put a turban clean on his head. And they put the turban the clean on his head and clothed him [with] garments; and [the] angel of Yahweh [was] standing.

en.L: And I said, "Let them put a clean turban on his head." And they put the clean turban on his head and clothed him with garments, while the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was standing by.
en.B: Then I said, "Let them place a clean turban on his head." They placed the clean turban on his head and dressed him in clothes, while the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stood by.
en.R: Then I said, "Have them put a clean turban on his head." So they put a clean turban on his head and dressed him in clothes, while the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stood by.

es.L: Y dije: «Que pongan un turbante limpio sobre su cabeza». Y pusieron el turbante limpio sobre su cabeza y lo vistieron con ropas, mientras el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaba de pie [allí].
es.B: Entonces dije: «Que le pongan un turbante limpio en la cabeza». Le pusieron el turbante limpio en la cabeza y lo vistieron, mientras el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaba presente.
es.R: Entonces dije: «{{plural_you:Pónganle|Ponedle}} un turbante limpio en la cabeza». Así que le pusieron un turbante limpio en la cabeza y lo vistieron, mientras el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaba allí.

fr.L: Et je dis : « Qu’on mette un turban pur sur sa tête. » Et ils mirent le turban pur sur sa tête et le revêtirent de vêtements, tandis que l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se tenait [là].
fr.B: Alors je dis : « Qu’on lui mette sur la tête un turban pur. » Ils lui mirent sur la tête le turban pur et l’habillèrent, tandis que l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} se tenait là.
fr.R: Alors j’ai dit : « Mettez-lui un turban propre sur la tête. » On lui a donc mis un turban propre sur la tête et on l’a habillé, pendant que l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} restait là.

sw.L: Nami nikasema, "Na wamvike kilemba safi kichwani mwake." Wakamvika kilemba safi kichwani mwake na kumvika mavazi, naye malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesimama [karibu].
sw.B: Kisha nikasema, "Wamvike kilemba safi kichwani." Wakamvika kilemba safi kichwani na kumvika nguo, huku malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akiwa amesimama karibu.
sw.R: Kisha nikasema, "Mvikeni kilemba safi kichwani." Basi wakamvika kilemba safi kichwani na kumvika nguo, huku malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akiwa amesimama pale.

vi.L: Tôi nói: "Hãy để họ đội một cái mão sạch trên đầu người." Họ đội cái mão sạch trên đầu người và mặc áo cho người, trong khi thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đứng [đó].
vi.B: Bấy giờ tôi nói: "Xin cho họ đội một cái mão sạch lên đầu ông ấy." Họ đội mão sạch lên đầu ông và mặc áo cho ông, trong khi thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đứng bên cạnh.
vi.R: Bấy giờ tôi nói: "Xin hãy đội cho ông ấy một cái mão sạch." Vậy họ đội cho ông một cái mão sạch và mặc áo cho ông, trong khi thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đứng bên cạnh.

ko.L: 그래서 내가 말하였다. "그의 머리에 깨끗한 관을 씌우게 하십시오." 그러자 그들이 그의 머리에 깨끗한 관을 씌우고 그에게 옷을 입혔으며, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사는 [곁에] 서 있었다.
ko.B: 그때 내가 말했다. "그의 머리에 깨끗한 관을 씌워 주십시오." 그들이 그의 머리에 깨끗한 관을 씌우고 옷을 입혔다. 그동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사는 곁에 서 있었다.
ko.R: 그때 내가 말했다. "그의 머리에도 깨끗한 관을 씌워 주십시오." 그래서 그들이 그의 머리에 깨끗한 관을 씌우고 옷을 입혔다. 그동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사는 곁에 서 있었다.

decisions.choice: and I said: Zechariah himself speaks
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text has "I said": the prophet, watching the scene, joins in and asks that the high priest's head be covered too. The Greek and Latin translations read "he said", making the angel the speaker. The Hebrew is the harder reading, and it is kept. This description of the ancient translations is written from general knowledge.

decisions.choice: a clean turban: the high priest's headdress
decisions.reason: The word is related to the name of the high priest's turban, which bore a gold plate engraved "Holy to the LORD" (Exodus 28:36-38). It is also used of a royal headdress (Isaiah 62:3). "Clean" is the word for what is fit for worship. Joshua is fully restored to his office.

decisions.choice: the angel of the LORD was standing by: he oversees what is done
decisions.reason: The angel remains in his place as the one in charge of the court, and in the next verse he speaks to Joshua.

decisions.choice: Have them put (R)
decisions.reason: In everyday English "let them put" can sound like giving permission; Readable says "have them put", a request that it be done.

decisions.choice: "turbante limpio"
decisions.reason: The high priest's headdress (m2) is a turban; "limpio" is the word for what is fit for worship.

decisions.choice: "mão sạch"
decisions.reason: "Mão" is the word for the high priest's headdress in Exodus 28; "sạch" keeps the sense of being fit for worship (m2).

decisions.choice: Zechariah's request in 합쇼체 ("씌우게 하십시오"); "관" for the turban
decisions.reason: Zechariah speaks into the heavenly court as he speaks to the angel. 관 is the word for the high priest's headdress (Exodus 28).

decisions.choice: solemnly charged: warned and instructed with all seriousness
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a solemn warning or charge given in the presence of witnesses (Genesis 43:3; Deuteronomy 8:19; Nehemiah 9:26). What follows is both a promise and a condition.

decisions.choice: solemnly charged (L); gave Joshua this solemn charge (B); spoke very seriously to Joshua (R)
decisions.reason: Each level gives the seriousness of the verb in words that suit it. The angel's words follow in quotation marks, which close at the end of verse 10.

source.text: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אִם־בִּדְרָכַ֤י תֵּלֵךְ֙ וְאִ֣ם אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְגַם־אַתָּה֙ תָּדִ֣ין אֶת־בֵּיתִ֔י וְגַ֖ם תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר אֶת־חֲצֵרָ֑י וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ מַהְלְכִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָעֹמְדִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts: If in my ways you will walk, and if my charge you will keep, and also you will judge my house, and also you will keep my courts, and I will give to you goings among these standing.

en.L: "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: If you will walk in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways, and if you will keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} charge, then you also will govern {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house and also keep charge of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} courts, and I will give you access among these who are standing here.
en.B: "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: If you walk in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways and carry out the duties I give you, then you will govern {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} house and take care of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} courts, and I will give you a place among those who stand here.
en.R: "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: If you live the way I want you to live and do the work I have given you, then you will be in charge of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} temple and its courtyards. And I will let you come and go among these who are standing here.

es.L: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: Si andas en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos, y si guardas {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ordenanza, entonces tú también gobernarás {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa, y también guardarás {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} atrios, y te daré acceso entre estos que están aquí de pie.
es.B: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: Si andas en {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos y cumples los deberes que te doy, entonces gobernarás {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} casa y cuidarás {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} atrios, y te daré un lugar entre los que están aquí.
es.R: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: Si vives como yo quiero que vivas y haces el trabajo que te he dado, entonces estarás a cargo de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} templo y de sus atrios. Y te dejaré ir y venir entre estos que están aquí.

fr.L: « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Si tu marches dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} voies, et si tu gardes {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} service, alors toi aussi tu gouverneras {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison, et tu garderas aussi {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} parvis, et je te donnerai accès parmi ceux qui se tiennent ici.
fr.B: « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées dit ceci : Si tu marches dans {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} voies et si tu remplis les fonctions que je te confie, alors tu gouverneras {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} maison et tu prendras soin de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} parvis, et je te donnerai une place parmi ceux qui se tiennent ici.
fr.R: « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Si tu vis comme je veux que tu vives et si tu fais le travail que je t’ai confié, alors tu seras responsable de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} temple et de ses cours. Et je te permettrai d’aller et venir parmi ceux qui se tiennent ici.

sw.L: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Ukienda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, na ukiyashika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, ndipo wewe nawe utaitawala nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, na pia utazilinda nyua {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakupa nafasi ya kwenda kati ya hawa waliosimama hapa.
sw.B: "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asemavyo: Ukienda katika njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kutimiza kazi ninazokupa, ndipo utaitawala nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na kuzitunza nyua {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitakupa nafasi kati ya hawa wanaosimama hapa.
sw.R: "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analosema: Ukiishi kama ninavyotaka uishi na kufanya kazi niliyokupa, ndipo utakuwa msimamizi wa hekalu {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} na nyua zake. Nami nitakuruhusu kuingia na kutoka kati ya hawa wanaosimama hapa.

vi.L: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Nếu ngươi bước đi trong các đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và nếu ngươi giữ điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giao phó, thì chính ngươi cũng sẽ cai quản nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, cũng sẽ coi sóc các hành lang {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho ngươi được ra vào giữa những vị đang đứng đây.
vi.B: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán như vầy: Nếu con bước đi trong đường lối {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và chu toàn những bổn phận {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} giao cho con, thì con sẽ cai quản nhà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và coi sóc các hành lang của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho con một chỗ giữa những vị đang đứng đây.
vi.R: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Nếu con sống theo cách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn và làm công việc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giao cho con, thì con sẽ được quản lý đền thờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và các sân của đền thờ. Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cho con được ra vào giữa những vị đang đứng đây.

ko.L: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 네가 만일 내 길로 행하고 내 직무를 지키면, 너도 내 집을 다스리고 내 뜰을 지킬 것이며, 내가 너에게 여기 서 있는 이들 사이에 드나들 자격을 주겠다.
ko.B: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 네가 내 길로 걷고 내가 맡긴 직무를 다하면, 너는 내 집을 다스리고 내 뜰을 돌보게 될 것이다. 그리고 내가 너에게 여기 서 있는 이들 가운데 자리를 주겠다.
ko.R: "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 네가 내가 원하는 대로 살고 내가 맡긴 일을 하면, 너는 내 성전과 그 뜰을 맡게 될 것이다. 그리고 내가 너를 여기 서 있는 이들 사이에서 드나들게 해 주겠다.

decisions.choice: two conditions and three promises: govern my house, keep my courts, and access among the angels
decisions.reason: The verse begins with "if" twice, and then three clauses begin with "and". The translation takes the turn at "also you": if Joshua obeys, he will govern the temple, keep its courts, and have access to the heavenly council. Others take all four of the first clauses as conditions, so that the only promise is the access at the end. In both readings, Joshua's office depends on his faithfulness.

decisions.choice: keep my charge: carry out the duties I have given you
decisions.reason: The phrase is used for the duties of priests and Levites in the service of the sanctuary (Leviticus 8:35; Numbers 3:7-8; Ezekiel 44:16).

decisions.choice: govern my house: rule over the temple and its worship
decisions.reason: The verb usually means to judge. Here it means to have authority over the temple: after the exile, with no king in Jerusalem, the high priest had charge of the temple and its affairs.

decisions.choice: access among these who are standing here: the right to come and go among the heavenly attendants
alternatives: guides from among these who stand here
decisions.reason: "These who are standing here" are the heavenly beings who serve the angel of the LORD (verse 4). The word translated "access" means "goings" or "places to walk". It probably means that Joshua will be free to come before God among his servants, as the true prophets stood in the LORD's council (Jeremiah 23:18, 22). Some take it to mean that the angels will be his guides.

decisions.choice: carry out the duties I give you (B); do the work I have given you (R); a place among (B); come and go among (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of "keep my charge" (m2) and of "goings" (m4). Readable says "temple" for "house" and "the way I want you to live" for "my ways".

decisions.choice: "guardas mi ordenanza" (L), "cumples los deberes que te doy" (B); "gobernarás mi casa"; "atrios"
decisions.reason: "Keep my charge" is the priests' phrase for the duties of the sanctuary (m2); Literal keeps it, the other levels give its sense. The angel's words open with « and run to the end of verse 10.

decisions.choice: God says "con" to Joshua (B, R), "ngươi" (L)
decisions.reason: The LORD's commission and promise to one man take "con" at Balanced and Readable, as the term sheet sets for commissions; Literal keeps "ngươi". The angel's words open with straight double quotes and close at the end of verse 10.

decisions.choice: the angel's "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다", then God's words in 해라체 with 나
decisions.reason: The angel of the LORD gives the formula with the honorific, and the words that follow are God's own, as in the oracles; the quotation runs to the end of verse 10.

source.text: שְֽׁמַֽע־נָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ׀הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְרֵעֶ֨יךָ֙ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־אַנְשֵׁ֥י מוֹפֵ֖ת הֵ֑מָּה כִּֽי־הִנְנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא אֶת־עַבְדִּ֖י צֶֽמַח׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear now, Joshua the priest the great, you and your companions who sit before you, for men of sign they [are]: for look, I [am] about to bring my servant Branch.

en.L: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your companions who sit before you, for they [are] men of a sign: for look, I am bringing {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant the Branch.
en.B: Listen, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellow priests who sit before you, for these men are a sign: I am about to bring {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, the Branch.
en.R: Listen, Joshua the high priest, you and the other priests who sit with you. These men are a sign of what I am going to do: I am going to bring {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant, the Branch.

es.L: Escucha ahora, Josué, sumo sacerdote, tú y tus compañeros que se sientan delante de ti, porque ellos [son] hombres de señal: porque he aquí, yo traigo a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo el Retoño.
es.B: Escucha, Josué, sumo sacerdote, tú y los sacerdotes compañeros tuyos que se sientan delante de ti, porque estos hombres son una señal: voy a traer a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, el Retoño.
es.R: Escucha, Josué, sumo sacerdote, tú y los demás sacerdotes que se sientan contigo. Estos hombres son una señal de lo que voy a hacer: voy a traer a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo, el Retoño.

fr.L: Écoute donc, Josué, grand prêtre, toi et tes compagnons qui siègent devant toi, car ce [sont] des hommes de présage : car voici, je fais venir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, le Germe.
fr.B: Écoute, Josué, grand prêtre, toi et tes collègues prêtres qui siègent devant toi, car ces hommes sont un signe : je vais faire venir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, le Germe.
fr.R: Écoute, Josué, grand prêtre, toi et les autres prêtres qui siègent avec toi. Ces hommes sont le signe de ce que je vais faire : je vais faire venir {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, le Germe.

sw.L: Sikia sasa, Yoshua kuhani mkuu, wewe na wenzako wanaoketi mbele yako, kwa maana wao [ni] watu wa ishara: kwa maana tazama, ninamleta mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Chipukizi.
sw.B: Sikiliza, Yoshua kuhani mkuu, wewe na makuhani wenzako wanaoketi mbele yako, kwa maana watu hawa ni ishara: Ninakaribia kumleta mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Chipukizi.
sw.R: Sikiliza, Yoshua kuhani mkuu, wewe na makuhani wengine wanaoketi pamoja nawe. Watu hawa ni ishara ya kile nitakachofanya: Nitamleta mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Chipukizi.

vi.L: Hỡi Giô-suê, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, hãy nghe đây, ngươi và các bạn đồng liêu ngồi trước mặt ngươi, vì họ [là] những người làm dấu lạ: vì kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Chồi đến.
vi.B: Hỡi Giô-suê, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, hãy lắng nghe, con và các thầy tế lễ đồng liêu ngồi trước mặt con, vì những người này là một dấu hiệu: Ta sắp đem đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Chồi đến.
vi.R: Hỡi Giô-suê, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, hãy lắng nghe, con và các thầy tế lễ khác ngồi cùng con. Những người này là dấu hiệu về điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp làm: Ta sẽ đem đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Chồi đến.

ko.L: 대제사장 여호수아야, 너와 네 앞에 앉은 네 동료들은 들어라. 그들은 징조의 사람들이다. 보라, 내가 나의 종 싹을 데려오겠다.
ko.B: 대제사장 여호수아야, 너와 네 앞에 앉아 있는 동료 제사장들은 들어라. 이 사람들은 징조이다. 내가 내 종 싹을 데려오겠다.
ko.R: 대제사장 여호수아야, 너와 너와 함께 앉아 있는 다른 제사장들은 들어라. 이 사람들은 내가 하려는 일을 보여 주는 표징이다. 내가 내 종 싹을 데려오겠다.

decisions.choice: your companions who sit before you: the other priests
decisions.reason: "Companions" are colleagues. The priests sit before the high priest as members of his council. They are named with him because the whole priesthood has been restored.

decisions.choice: men of a sign: people whose presence points to something still to come
decisions.reason: The word means a sign or portent, something that points beyond itself (Isaiah 8:18; 20:3; Ezekiel 12:6, 11). The cleansed priests are a pledge that God will do what he now promises: bring his servant, the Branch.

decisions.choice: my servant the Branch: the coming king from David's line
decisions.reason: "Branch" means new growth springing from a plant. Jeremiah used it for the righteous king God would raise up for David (Jeremiah 23:5; 33:15), and "my servant" is a title of David and his heir (Ezekiel 34:23-24; 37:24). Here the Branch is promised as someone still to come. In 6:12 a man named Branch will build the LORD's temple, and many readers connect him with Zerubbabel, the governor of David's line who led the rebuilding (4:9; Haggai 2:23). Jewish tradition read the Branch as the Messiah, and Christians see the promise fulfilled in Jesus, the son of David. The text names the Branch and leaves his identity to be shown.

decisions.choice: the Branch, with a capital letter, at every level; servant, lowercase
decisions.reason: As set for the prophets, "Branch" is capitalized as a title, as in Jeremiah 23:5, and "servant" stays lowercase, as Isaiah's servant does. The Branch takes no deity_pronoun setting. Balanced and Readable say "Listen" for "Hear now", and Readable makes the sign a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo el Retoño", capitalized; "siervo" lowercase; no span on the Branch
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Jeremiah 23:5 in Spanish: "Retoño" is a title, so it is capitalized, while God's servant stays lowercase and takes no pronoun setting of his own.

decisions.choice: "{{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur, le Germe"
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah 23:5 in French: "le Germe" is capitalized as a title at every level; the Branch himself takes no pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, Chipukizi"
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah 23:5 in Swahili: "Chipukizi" is capitalized as a title; "wangu" is God's own possessive and takes the setting, the Branch takes none.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ Ta là Chồi"
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah 23:5 in Vietnamese: "Chồi" is capitalized as a title at every level and takes no deity span; "Ta" is God's own pronoun.

decisions.choice: "나의 종 싹" (L), "내 종 싹" (B, R), with no -시-
decisions.reason: 싹 is the word of Isaiah 4:2 and Jeremiah 23:5 in Korean, so the passages stay linked; the Branch takes no honorific.

source.text: כִּ֣י׀הִנֵּ֣ה הָאֶ֗בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֨תִּי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עַל־אֶ֥בֶן אַחַ֖ת שִׁבְעָ֣ה עֵינָ֑יִם הִנְנִ֧י מְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתֻּחָ֗הּ נְאֻם֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּמַשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־עֲוֺ֥ן הָאָֽרֶץ־הַהִ֖יא בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: For look, the stone which I have set before Joshua: on stone one seven eyes; look, I [am] engraving its engraving, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of the land the that in day one.

en.L: For look, the stone that I have placed before Joshua: upon one stone, seven eyes. Look, I am engraving its inscription, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, and I will remove that land's iniquity in one day.
en.B: Look at the stone I have placed before Joshua. That one stone has seven eyes. I am going to engrave an inscription on it, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, and I will remove the guilt of that land in a single day.
en.R: Look at the stone I have placed in front of Joshua. There are seven eyes on that one stone. I am going to carve words on it, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. And in a single day I will take away the sin of that land.

es.L: Porque he aquí la piedra que he puesto delante de Josué: sobre una piedra, siete ojos. He aquí, yo grabaré su inscripción, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, y quitaré la iniquidad de esa tierra en un día.
es.B: Mira la piedra que he puesto delante de Josué. Esa sola piedra tiene siete ojos. Voy a grabar en ella una inscripción, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, y quitaré la culpa de esa tierra en un solo día.
es.R: Mira la piedra que he puesto frente a Josué. En esa única piedra hay siete ojos. Voy a tallar palabras en ella, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Y en un solo día quitaré el pecado de esa tierra.

fr.L: Car voici la pierre que j’ai placée devant Josué : sur une seule pierre, sept yeux. Voici, je grave son inscription, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et j’ôterai la faute de ce pays en un seul jour.
fr.B: Regarde la pierre que j’ai placée devant Josué. Cette pierre unique a sept yeux. Je vais y graver une inscription, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, et j’enlèverai la faute de ce pays en un seul jour.
fr.R: Regarde la pierre que j’ai placée devant Josué. Il y a sept yeux sur cette seule pierre. Je vais y graver des mots, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées. Et en un seul jour, j’enlèverai le péché de ce pays.

sw.L: Kwa maana tazama, jiwe nililoliweka mbele ya Yoshua: juu ya jiwe moja, macho saba. Tazama, ninachora maandishi yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaondoa uovu wa nchi ile katika siku moja.
sw.B: Tazama jiwe nililoliweka mbele ya Yoshua. Jiwe hilo moja lina macho saba. Nitachora maandishi juu yake, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaiondoa hatia ya nchi ile katika siku moja tu.
sw.R: Tazama jiwe nililoliweka mbele ya Yoshua. Kuna macho saba juu ya jiwe hilo moja. Nitachonga maneno juu yake, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Na katika siku moja tu nitaiondoa dhambi ya nchi ile.

vi.L: Vì kìa, hòn đá mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt trước mặt Giô-suê: trên một hòn đá có bảy con mắt. Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ khắc chữ trên đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất tội ác của xứ ấy đi trong một ngày.
vi.B: Hãy nhìn hòn đá {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt trước mặt Giô-suê. Một hòn đá ấy có bảy con mắt. Ta sẽ khắc chữ lên đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất tội lỗi của xứ ấy đi chỉ trong một ngày.
vi.R: Hãy nhìn hòn đá {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt trước mặt Giô-suê. Trên một hòn đá ấy có bảy con mắt. Ta sẽ khắc chữ lên đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán. Và chỉ trong một ngày, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất tội lỗi của xứ ấy đi.

ko.L: 보라, 내가 여호수아 앞에 둔 돌이다. 한 돌 위에 일곱 눈이 있다. 보라, 내가 거기에 새길 글을 새기겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 그 땅의 죄악을 하루에 없애겠다.
ko.B: 내가 여호수아 앞에 놓은 돌을 보아라. 그 한 돌에 눈 일곱이 있다. 내가 그 돌에 글을 새기겠다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그리고 내가 그 땅의 죄를 단 하루 만에 없애겠다.
ko.R: 내가 여호수아 앞에 놓은 돌을 보아라. 그 한 돌 위에 눈이 일곱 개 있다. 내가 그 돌에 글자를 새기겠다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그리고 단 하루 만에 내가 그 땅의 죄를 없애겠다.

decisions.choice: the stone: a stone that God himself sets in place and engraves
alternatives: a building stone of the temple
a precious stone of the high priest's garments
decisions.reason: The text does not say what the stone is. It may be a building stone of the new temple, such as the top stone of 4:7 or the stone of 4:10. It may be a gem like those engraved and set on the high priest's garments (Exodus 28:9-12), or the gold plate of his turban, engraved "Holy to the LORD" (Exodus 28:36). Because it follows the promise of the Branch, some read it as a picture of him (compare Psalm 118:22; Isaiah 28:16). The translation keeps the picture without choosing.

decisions.choice: seven eyes: eyes, the LORD's watchful care
decisions.reason: The word means "eye", and also "spring" of water and, perhaps, the face of a gem. In 4:10 "these seven" are "the eyes of the LORD, which range through the whole earth", so the stone is most likely marked with the LORD's eyes: his care and knowledge set on it. Some read seven facets cut in a gem.

decisions.choice: I am engraving its inscription: the words of engraved stones and gold
decisions.reason: The verb and noun are those used for engraving the names of the tribes on the high priest's stones and "Holy to the LORD" on his gold plate (Exodus 28:11, 21, 36). The inscription itself is not given.

decisions.choice: I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day: a single act of cleansing for the whole land
decisions.reason: What was done for Joshua (verse 4) will be done for the land. The Day of Atonement cleansed the people of their sins once a year (Leviticus 16:30); here God promises a day that will take away the land's guilt. Zechariah 13:1 speaks of a fountain opened on that day to cleanse sin. Christian readers have heard in "one day" the death of Jesus, offered "once for all" (Hebrews 10:10-14).

decisions.choice: iniquity (L); guilt (B); sin (R); carve words on it (R)
decisions.reason: The wording for iniquity follows the table, as in verse 4. Readable says "carve words" for "engrave its inscription". Balanced and Readable say "look at" for the first "look", since the stone is pointed out.

decisions.choice: "siete ojos" at every level; "iniquidad" (L), "culpa" (B), "pecado" (R)
decisions.reason: The stone and its eyes are kept as seen, as the English keeps them (m1, m2); the word for iniquity follows the levels of verse 4.

records.literal_gloss: In the day the that, declaration of Yahweh of hosts, you will call each to his neighbor to under [the] vine and to under [the] fig tree.

en.L: In that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, you will call, each one to {{gender:their|his}} neighbor, [to come] under [the] vine and under [the] fig tree."
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, each of you will invite your neighbor to come and sit under your vine and your fig tree."
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, all of you will invite your neighbors to come and sit with you under your grapevines and fig trees."

es.L: En aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, {{plural_you:invitarán|invitaréis}}, cada uno a su prójimo, [a venir] debajo de la vid y debajo de la higuera».
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} invitará a su vecino a venir y sentarse bajo su vid y bajo su higuera».
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} invitará a sus vecinos a venir a sentarse con él bajo sus vides y sus higueras».

fr.L: En ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, vous vous inviterez, chacun son prochain, [à venir] sous la vigne et sous le figuier. »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, chacun de vous invitera son voisin à venir s’asseoir sous sa vigne et sous son figuier. »
fr.R: En ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, vous inviterez tous vos voisins à venir s’asseoir avec vous sous vos vignes et vos figuiers. »

sw.L: Katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, mtaitana, kila mtu na jirani yake, [kuja] chini ya mzabibu na chini ya mtini."
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, kila mmoja wenu atamkaribisha jirani yake aje kuketi chini ya mzabibu wake na mtini wake."
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, kila mmoja wenu atawakaribisha jirani zake waje kuketi pamoja naye chini ya mizabibu na mitini yake."

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, các ngươi sẽ gọi nhau, mỗi người gọi người lân cận mình, [đến ngồi] dưới cây nho và dưới cây vả."
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán vậy, mỗi người trong các ngươi sẽ mời người lân cận mình đến ngồi dưới cây nho và cây vả của mình."
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán, tất cả các ngươi sẽ mời láng giềng mình đến ngồi chung dưới những gốc nho và cây vả của mình."

ko.L: 그날에 너희는 각자 자기 이웃을 포도나무 아래와 무화과나무 아래로 부를 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다."
ko.B: 그날에 너희는 저마다 이웃을 불러 자기 포도나무와 무화과나무 아래에 함께 앉자고 청할 것이다. 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."
ko.R: 그때에 너희는 모두 이웃들을 불러 너희 포도나무와 무화과나무 아래에 함께 앉자고 할 것이다. 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다."

decisions.choice: under the vine and under the fig tree: a picture of peace and plenty
decisions.reason: Sitting under one's own vine and fig tree is the Bible's picture of a peaceful life in the land, safe from war and want (1 Kings 5:5; Micah 4:4). Here neighbors invite one another to share it.

decisions.choice: you will call, each to his neighbor: the people will invite one another
decisions.reason: "You" is plural: the people of the land, whose guilt has been taken away (verse 9). "Each to his neighbor" means everyone, men and women, inviting one another.

decisions.choice: their / his (L, gender setting); your neighbor (B); your neighbors (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase means everyone, so Literal gives the pronoun the gender setting, and Balanced and Readable say "each of you" and "all of you", which are already inclusive. Balanced and Readable add "sit", which the picture implies. The closing mark ends the angel's words begun in verse 7.

decisions.choice: "cada uno a su prójimo", with plural_you on the verb and no gender span
decisions.reason: The "you" is plural (m2), so it takes plural_you; Spanish "su" covers men and women, so the English gender setting is not needed. The closing » ends the angel's words begun in verse 7.
